name: George Partridge
bio: A Delegate and a Representative from Massachusetts; born in Duxbury, Mass., February 8, 1740; graduated from Harvard College in 1762; taught school in Kingston, Mass.; studied theology; delegate to the Massachusetts Provincial Congress in 1774 and 1775; member of the Massachusetts state house of representatives, 1775-1779; sheriff of Plymouth County, 1777-1812; Delegate to the Second Continental Congress, 1779-1780; Delegate to the Confederation Congress, 1781-1785; member of the Massachusetts state house of representatives in 1788; elected as a Pro-Administration candidate to the First Congress (March 4, 1789 - March 3, 1791); unsuccessful candidate for reelection to the Second Congress in 1790; endowed Partridge Seminary in Duxbury; died in Duxbury, Plymouth County, Mass., on July 7, 1828; interment in Mayflower Cemetery.
